按中性层 K 因子法计算，A、B 为成形后的外侧边长。: Uses the neutral-axis K-factor method. A and B are the formed outside leg lengths.
采用对应母线三角形法，点位从偏心方向起按圆周等分。: Uses triangulated true lengths. Circumference points start in the offset direction.
按等角虾米腰、两端半节模型计算，点位为管周 12 等分切口高度。: Uses equal-angle segments with half-pieces at both ends. Heights are shown at 12 circumference points.
按两圆柱轴线相交的解析模型计算，点位从支管圆周基准点开始。: Uses intersecting-cylinder geometry. Points start at the branch circumference reference.
按方口与圆口周长等分的三角形法计算，点位从方口右上方向顺时针编号。: Uses triangulated divisions of both perimeters. Points run clockwise from the upper-right reference.
当前设备没有可用的分享方式: Sharing is unavailable on this device.
没有找到构件，试试“弯头”或“大小头”: No shapes found. Try elbow or reducer.
所有尺寸与角度必须大于 0: All dimensions and angles must be positive.
折弯角度必须小于 180°: Bend angle must be less than 180°.
K 因子必须在 0–1 之间: K factor must be between 0 and 1.
大端直径必须大于小端直径: Large diameter must exceed small diameter.
偏心距过大，小端轮廓已超出大端: Offset is too large: the small end extends beyond the large end.
中心弯曲半径不能小于管道半径: Centerline radius cannot be less than the pipe radius.
弯头角度必须小于 180°: Elbow angle must be less than 180°.
支管直径不能大于主管直径: Branch diameter cannot exceed main diameter.
轴线夹角须在 10°–170° 之间: Axis angle must be between 10° and 170°.
偏心距过大，两个端面投影无法形成有效过渡: Offset is too large to form a valid transition.
@0@须为 @1@–@2@ 之间的整数: @0@ must be a whole number from @1@ to @2@.
内部计算保留完整精度，显示精度可在设置中调整。: Calculations retain full precision. Set displayed decimal places in Settings.
采用 BA = πθ/180 × (R + Kt) 计算中性层折弯余量，再由外侧: Bend allowance BA = πθ/180 × (R + Kt). Bend deduction uses the outside setbacks.
将大小端圆周对应等分点连接，使用三维距离公式逐点求各条素线实长。: Connect corresponding circumference points and use 3D distances to find each true length.
按等角虾米腰、两端半节模型划分转角，斜切口使用圆柱与斜平面相交的正弦曲线。: Equal-angle segments and half-pieces at both ends define the joints. Miter profiles use cylinder-plane intersection curves.
建立两个相交圆柱的解析方程，按支管圆周等分求每个相贯点高度。: Intersecting-cylinder equations give cut heights at divided branch circumference points.
将方口周长与圆口圆周等分，以三角形法逐点计算连接素线和近似侧面积。: Triangulate divided rectangular and round perimeter points for true lengths and approximate side area.
结果不自动包含咬口、焊缝、折边、切割缝和材料回弹补偿。: Results exclude seam, weld, flange, kerf and springback allowances.
不作为 1:1 打印模板，实际加工前请复核。: Not a 1:1 cutting template. Verify before fabrication.
分段数须为 6–96 之间的整数: Divisions must be a whole number from 6 to 96.
分段数越大，展开越精细，建议 12–24 段。: More divisions give a finer layout. Typically use 12–24.
按理想几何中性层计算。母线长度由高度与两端半径差求得，再由相似三角形得到展开扇形: Uses ideal neutral-surface geometry. Height and radius difference give the slant length; similar triangles give sector radii and angle.
适用条件：A ＞ B ＞ 0，分段数 6–96。结果不含咬口、焊缝、折边和切割余: Requires A > B > 0 and 6–96 divisions. Results exclude seams, welds, flanges and cutting allowances.
不作为 1:1 打印模板，请以实际放样为准。: Not a 1:1 template. Use verified layout dimensions.
计算完成后点“存入项目”，结果会离线保存在这里。: Choose Save to project after calculating. Results stay on this device.
此操作无法撤销，项目中已保存的构件不会被删除。: This cannot be undone. Components saved to projects will remain.
每次有效计算都会自动保存在本机，最多保留 100 条。: Completed calculations are saved on this device, up to 100 entries.
计算页支持 mm、cm、m 即时切换，内部始终以毫米保留完整精度。: Switch between mm, cm and m. Internal calculations retain full precision in millimetres.
本 App 无账号、无广告、无分析 SDK。参数、历史和项目不会上传到服务器。删: No accounts, ads or analytics SDKs. Inputs, history and projects are not uploaded. Uninstalling removes app-local data.
只有在你点击“分享”后，结果文本才会交给 iOS 系统分享面板。App 不会在后: Result text is passed to the system share sheet only when you choose Share. The app does not send it in the background.
结果基于用户输入和理想几何模型，用于辅助计算与放样。实际加工前请结合图纸、材料、: Results use your inputs and ideal geometry. Check drawings, materials, thickness, seams, welds, process allowances and site measurements before fabrication. Make a test piece when needed.
